currentState: Guard and prisoner, wary and practical, now with a working edge: Cyndia relies on the mage's heavy-or-light calls to produce her count; she also wraps the mage's hands on Sylvanas's order and gives the child her skin without a word. Neither speaks to the other directly on page in chapter 3.
powerDynamic: Cyndia holds the satchel, the staff and the keys in Ch2 and can stop Jaina with a word ('Slowly.'). In chapter 3 their exchange runs through Sylvanas ('Mage. Can you tell her which marks are which?'); Cyndia turns her head to each mark as the mage calls it.
currentState_chapter5: Chapter 5: still no direct address on page. Cyndia takes Jaina's weight on her arm through the depot door and carries her to the gate; Jaina stands against the doorframe while Cyndia counts; both read the same map (Cyndia's books and Jaina's marks) and agree. Cyndia notes Hollow Green is in no book and the mage moves her mark.
currentState_chapter4: Still no direct address between them. Cyndia rides Jaina's left; she reports to Sylvanas with Jaina in the room (the supply chain, at the chapel), opens the granary side door with Jaina behind her, stands at the stair head; Jaina notes Cyndia's name by narration only. Cyndia keeps a bow ready beside Jaina in the loft; she and Lyriel cut Tam loose and haul him up while Jaina holds the frost. No friction, no warmth.

physicalDynamics.pattern: Chapter 4: Cyndia takes the left flank beside Jaina at the village entry, speaking across Jaina's shoulder ('Ranger-General. Shutters up on three houses, this side...'); Jaina cranes over Cyndia's shoulder to see the shutters; in the loft Cyndia stands at the edge with an arrow on her string; at dawn goes round the girths without looking up.
Cyndia turns sideways past Jaina's chair, braid brushing her shoulder; pulls the wedge stone; hands the staff haft first; holds out a water skin.
Cyndia puts her horse between the doe and Jaina's mare; says 'Slowly' when Jaina reaches for the satchel.

Chapter 3: Cyndia kneels behind the mage on the clay in the cut as she moves along the staff, laying hazel switches; wraps the mage's hands in strips of linen on Sylvanas's order; turns her head to each 'heavy' or 'light'.

nameUsage.cyndiaCallsJaina: Never names or titles her; third-person 'the mage' through Sylvanas; no direct address on page.

history.event: Cyndia arrested her, racked her gear, and logged it (chapter 1). She now notes Jaina left the noon bowl and has eaten nothing since.
Cyndia protects Jaina in the ambush, then warns her 'Slowly' at the satchel.
Cyndia's count in the cut depends on the mage's staff calls; she says 'A cow' to the first light mark and accepts the call.

trajectory: Professional suspicion giving way to a working reliance; still no names or talk.
